prompt: Which source brought each German July 2025 signup to the site last before signing up? For each user with country_code 'DE' who signed up in July 2025 (signup_ts holds UTC time; 1 to 31 July, both days included, in UTC), look at the sessions of the user's visitor_id that started at or before signup_ts, and take the utm_source of the latest of them. When two of those sessions tie on session_start, the one with the higher session_id counts as the later one. A missing utm_source stays missing. Return two columns, in this order: user_id and last_touch_source. Return one row for each such user with a session at or before signing up. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, collect each July signup's sessions up to the moment of signing up, then put the source of the latest one on each of the user's rows.
The window must see all of a user's sessions, the first to the last, on every row; then keep one row per user.
why_this_works: The frame covers all of a user's sessions, so LAST_VALUE gives the latest session's source on every row, and DISTINCT keeps one row per user.
